title: SQL bug hunts
description: Mallowfield Seeds posts packets of seed from a shed and sells them at a Saturday market stall, and it runs on a handful of SQL reports that nobody has questioned until the numbers stopped matching what the team counts by hand. You work through five tickets, each a report that runs without an error and is quietly wrong: prove it with the rows that break it, fix the query at the cause, then find the same trap in a second report before anyone notices. You learn to spot a join that multiplies, the NULL that makes rows vanish, a LEFT JOIN that is no longer one, sums and averages that lie, and dates and ties that shift under a report.
